patch.value: Forecast compatibility with named Beads producer dialects before import

Acceptance: two fixture dialects produce deterministic field-level exact, sidecar-dependent and unsupported forecasts; every exact mapping passes a real SDK round trip; unsupported native nesting refuses before import. Deliver typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, typed remedies, README/example, seeded model evidence and read-only public tracker measurement.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against installed host SDK declarations, package commands and sibling pm-csv, pm-memory, pm-context and pm-ops sources. Host SDK has no named Beads producer forecast; pm-csv dialect descriptors concern table syntax and column mappings. Existing Beads sidecars preserve opted-in unknown top-level JSON; reconciliation, transfers and outgoing deltas exchange canonical snapshots. This feature forecasts named producer compatibility, reusing these mapping and sidecar functions. Forecast is read-only, has no journal or mutable coordinator, and promises no lock isolation; existing transaction leases do not exclude ordinary SDK writers.
